title: Top-Flight Football on an Entry-Level Camera
excerpt: Photography student Chantelle Cook shadowed Motherwell FC's club photographer with her Canon EOS R50 and came home with pro-worthy shots. The three autofocus settings that made the difference.

title: Shoot Every Landscape Three Times: Wide, Medium, Close
excerpt: A filmmaker's coverage trick, one wide, one medium, one close, turns a single sunrise location into a full sequence. Here is the three-frame exercise worth stealing.

title: What f/1.2 Actually Buys You After Dark
excerpt: Nikon's three f/1.2 primes each weigh more than a kilogram. Night shooter Jack Wang tested them against their f/1.8 siblings, and the real lesson is not about light at all.
